prompt:
Build a todo list web app. Make it look and feel like a professional Microsoft web app.

It needs: add a task, mark a task complete, delete a task, and filter between all, active, and completed tasks. Start with these 5 tasks, with the 2nd and 5th already completed: "Review the quarterly budget", "Email the design team", "Book a room for the offsite", "Draft the project kickoff agenda", "Update the onboarding checklist".

Build the settings page for our web app. It needs a profile section (display name, email, job title), notification preferences (email digest on or off, mentions on or off, and a digest frequency of daily or weekly), and appearance (light, dark, or match system). Saving should confirm the changes. Make it look and feel like a professional Microsoft web app. Prefill the profile with Megan Bowen, megan.bowen@fabrikam.com, Marketing manager.

Build an admin page for managing our team members. Show 12 sample members with name, email, role (Owner, Admin, Member), status (Active, Invited, Suspended), and last active date. Let me search by name or email, filter by role, invite a new member with a form, and remove a member. Make it look and feel like a professional Microsoft web app.

Build an expense tracker. I want to add an expense with a description, amount, category (Travel, Meals, Supplies, Software), and date, see all expenses in a list, delete one, and see the total for each category. Start with 8 sample expenses. Make it look and feel like a professional Microsoft web app.

Build an email client for our team. It needs a folder list (Inbox, Sent, Drafts, Archive) with unread counts, a message list showing sender, subject, a preview, and the time, and a reading pane that shows the selected message. Let me compose a new message, reply, archive, delete, mark a message read or unread, and search my messages. Start with 15 sample messages in the inbox. Make it look and feel like a professional Microsoft web app.

Build a project tracker for our software team. Show issues on a board with To do, In progress, In review, and Done columns, and let me switch to a list view. Each issue has a title, an ID, an assignee, a priority (Urgent, High, Medium, Low), and labels. Let me create an issue, open one to see and edit its details in a side panel, move it to another column, filter by assignee and priority, and delete it. Start with 14 sample issues. Make it look and feel like a professional Microsoft web app.

Build a file manager for our cloud storage. Show folders and files with name, owner, modified date, and size, with a breadcrumb for the current folder. Let me open folders, switch between a list and a grid view, select several items to move, download, or delete them together, rename an item, create a folder, and upload a file (just add it to the list). Show storage used out of 1 TB. Start with a realistic folder tree. Make it look and feel like a professional Microsoft web app.
